comment: Verified Bangla corpus manifest. Each source carries license/provenance metadata; review each license before downloading. Raw data stays in data/raw/ (git-ignored) and is never committed. See data/README.md for source notes.

datasets.name: bn_wikipedia
datasets.provenance: Bengali Wikipedia dump via the wikimedia/wikipedia Hugging Face dataset (20231101.bn config, train split). Extracted `text` column only.
datasets.notes: High-quality encyclopedia text. Wikimedia terms apply; verify CC-BY-SA-4.0 compatibility before training use.

datasets.name: samanantar_bn
datasets.provenance: AI4Bharat Samanantar parallel corpus, Bengali (bn) side. Aligned sentence pairs; only the bn field is ingested as monolingual text.
datasets.notes: Large en<->bn parallel corpus. CC-BY-SA-4.0; attribution required.

datasets.name: oscar_cc100_bn
datasets.provenance: OSCAR / CC-100 Bengali web crawl subset (2209 release). Noisy web text; must pass Phase-B spam/toxic/dedup filtering.
datasets.notes: Web crawl, noisy. Common Crawl-derived terms apply; verify ODC-BY compatibility before training use.

datasets.name: bn_wikinews
datasets.provenance: Bengali Wikinews dump via the wikimedia/wikipedia Hugging Face dataset (20231101.bn_wikinews config).
datasets.notes: Smaller, clean wiki news project. CC-BY-SA-4.0.

datasets.name: bn_wikiquote
datasets.provenance: Bengali Wikiquote dump via the wikimedia/wikipedia Hugging Face dataset (20231101.bn_wikiquote config).
datasets.notes: Smaller, clean wiki quotation project. CC-BY-SA-4.0.
